Figure 2 DIKW Multi-Agent System Architecture. An orchestrator agent determines analytical topics, which are assigned to specialized agents at four levels: the D-Agent validates data integrity, the I-Agent extracts statistical patterns through code execution, the K-Agent synthesizes findings into behavioral principles, and the W-Agent translates principles into intervention designs. The human researcher reviews and approves the plan before execution begins.
